The season began on 4 February and ended on 13 November 2022.{{cite web|url=https://www.hoy.com.py/deportes/sin-cambios-en-el-sistema-de-la-copa-de-primera|title=Sin cambios en el sistema de la Copa de Primera|trans-title=No changes in the Copa de Primera system|language=Spanish|publisher=Diario HOY|date=10 December 2021|access-date=12 December 2021}} The fixtures for the season were announced on 14 December 2021.{{cite web|url=https://www.hoy.com.py/deportes/se-vienen-los-premios-de-primera-2021|title=Se vienen los Premios de Primera 2021|trans-title=The 2021 ''Premios de Primera'' are coming|language=Spanish|publisher=Diario HOY|date=6 December 2021|access-date=12 December 2021}}{{cite web|url=https://www.apf.org.py/n/la-agenda-de-primera-para-el-2022|title=La agenda de Primera para el 2022|trans-title=''Primera''’s agenda for 2022|language=Spanish|publisher=[[Paraguayan Football Association|APF]]|date=14 December 2021|access-date=18 December 2021}} {{Dead link|date=September 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }} In the Torneo Apertura [[Club Libertad|Libertad]] won their twenty-second league championship, clinching the title with one match in hand after beating [[Cerro Porteño]] by a 1–0 score on 25 June,{{cite web|url=https://versus.lanacion.com.py/versus/2022/06/25/libertad-conquista-el-titulo-22-con-su-gente/|title=Libertad levanta el título 22 con su gente|trans-title=Libertad lift the 22nd title with their people|language=Spanish|publisher=Versus|date=25 June 2022|access-date=25 June 2022}} whilst the Torneo Clausura was won by [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]], who claimed their forty-sixth league title after drawing 1–1 with [[Club Nacional|Nacional]] on the last matchday played on 12 November.{{cite web|url=https://d10.ultimahora.com//olimpia-festeja-la-46-un-sufrido-partido-nacional-n3033496.html|title=Olimpia festeja la 46 tras un sufrido partido ante Nacional|trans-title=Olimpia celebrate the 46th after a hard-fought match against Nacional|language=Spanish|publisher=D10|date=12 November 2022|access-date=12 November 2022}} Cerro Porteño were the defending champions, having won the [[2021 Paraguayan Primera División season#Torneo Clausura|2021 Clausura]] tournament. ==Teams== Twelve teams competed in the season: the top eight teams in the relegation table of the [[2021 Paraguayan Primera División season#Relegation table|2021 season]], the top three teams in the [[2021 Paraguayan División Intermedia]] ([[Club General Caballero (Juan León Mallorquín)|General Caballero (JLM)]], [[Resistencia S.C.|Resistencia]], and [[Tacuary]]), as well as [[Sportivo Ameliano]], winners of the [[2021 Paraguayan Primera División season#Promotion/relegation play-off|promotion/relegation play-off]]. The promoted teams replaced [[Club River Plate (Asunción)|River Plate]] and [[Sportivo Luqueño]], who were relegated to the second tier at the end of the previous season. ===Stadia and locations=== {{Location map+ |Paraguay |float=right |width=400 |caption=Locations of the '''2022 Primera División''' teams |places= {{Location map~ |Paraguay |lat=-25.30 |long=-57.633333 |label='''Asunción''' |position=left |mark=Arrows 12x12 e.svg}} {{Location map~ |Paraguay |lat=-25.395917 |long=-57.340694 |label=
